verses.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.pt: Falou, pois, Saul a Jônatas, seu filho, e a todos os seus servos, para que matassem a Davi. Porém Jônatas, filho de Saul, estava muito afeiçoado a Davi.
verses.en_web: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul gave orders to his son Jonathan and to all his servants to put David to death. But Saul's son Jonathan had great delight in David.

verses.en: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:
verses.pt: Pelo que Jônatas o anunciou a Davi, dizendo: Saul, meu pai, procura matar-te; portanto, guarda-te amanhã pela manhã, fica num lugar oculto e esconde-te;
verses.en_web: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, and live in a secret place, and hide yourself.
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan said to David, Saul, my father, is purposing your death: so now, take care in the morning, and keep yourself safe in a secret place:

verses.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.
verses.pt: eu sairei e me porei ao lado de meu pai no campo em que estiveres; falarei acerca de ti a meu pai, verei o que há, e to anunciarei.
verses.en_web: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will go out and take my place by my father's side in the field near where you are; and I will get into talk with my father about you, and when I see how things are, I will give you word.

verses.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:
verses.pt: Então Jônatas falou bem de Davi a Saul, seu pai, e disse-lhe: Não peque o rei contra seu servo Davi, porque ele não pecou contra ti, e porque os seus feitos para contigo têm sido muito bons.
verses.en_web: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;
verses.en_bbe: And Jonathan gave his father Saul a good account of David, and said to him, Let not the king do wrong against his servant, against David; because he has done you no wrong, and all his acts have had a good outcome for you:

verses.en: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.pt: Porque expôs a sua vida e matou o filisteu, e o Senhor fez um grande livramento para todo o Israel. Tu mesmo o viste, e te alegraste; por que, pois, pecarias contra o sangue inocente, matando sem causa a Davi?
verses.en_web: for he put his life in his hand, and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it, and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”
verses.en_bbe: For he put his life in danger and overcame the Philistine, and the Lord gave all Israel salvation: you saw it and were glad: why then are you sinning against him who has done no wrong, desiring the death of David without cause?

verses.en: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.
verses.pt: E Saul deu ouvidos à voz de Jônatas, e jurou: Como vive o Senhor, Davi não morrera.
verses.en_web: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan: and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul gave ear to the voice of Jonathan, and said with an oath, By the living Lord, he is not to be put to death.

verses.en: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.
verses.pt: Jônatas, pois, chamou a Davi, contou-lhe todas estas palavras, e o levou a Saul; e Davi o assistia como dantes.
verses.en_web: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as before.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jonathan sent for David and gave him word of all these things. And Jonathan took David to Saul, who kept him by his side as in the past.

verses.en: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
verses.pt: Depois tornou a haver guerra; e saindo Davi, pelejou contra os filisteus, e os feriu com grande matança, e eles fugiram diante dele.
verses.en_web: There was war again. David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.
verses.en_bbe: And there was war again: and David went out fighting the Philistines, causing great destruction among them; and they went in flight before him.

verses.en: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
verses.pt: Então o espírito maligno da parte do Senhor veio sobre Saul, estando ele sentado em sua casa, e tendo na mão a sua lança; e Davi estava tocando a harpa.
verses.en_web: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing with his hand.
verses.en_bbe: And an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul, when he was seated in his house with his spear in his hand; and David made music for him.

verses.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.pt: E Saul procurou encravar a Davi na parede, porém ele se desviou de diante de Saul, que fincou a lança na parede. Então Davi fugiu, e escapou naquela mesma noite.
verses.en_web: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled, and escaped that night.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul would have sent his spear through him, pinning him to the wall, but he got away and the spear went into the wall: and that night David went in flight and got away.

verses.en: Saul also sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David’s wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
verses.pt: Mas Saul mandou mensageiros à casa de Davi, para que o vigiassem, e o matassem pela manhã; porém Mical, mulher de Davi, o avisou, dizendo: Se não salvares a tua vida esta noite, amanhã te matarão.
verses.en_web: Saul sent messengers to David’s house, to watch him, and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”
verses.en_bbe: Then in that night Saul sent men to David's house to keep watch on him so as to put him to death in the morning: and David's wife Michal said to him, If you do not go away to a safe place tonight you will be put to death in the morning.

verses.en: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.
verses.pt: Então Mical desceu Davi por uma janela, e ele se foi e, fugindo, escapou.
verses.en_web: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
verses.en_bbe: So Michal let David down through the window, and he went in flight and got away.

verses.en: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
verses.pt: Mical tomou uma estátua, deitou-a na cama, pôs-lhe à cabeceira uma pele de cabra, e a cobriu com uma capa.
verses.en_web: Michal took the teraphim, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head, and covered it with clothes.
verses.en_bbe: Then Michal took the image and put it in the bed, with a cushion of goat's hair at its head, and she put clothing over it.

verses.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
verses.pt: Quando Saul enviou mensageiros para prenderem a Davi, ela disse: Está doente.
verses.en_web: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Saul sent men to take David, she said, He is ill.

verses.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.
verses.pt: Tornou Saul a enviá-los, para que vissem a Davi, dizendo-lhes: Trazei-mo na cama, para que eu o mate.
verses.en_web: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul sent his men to see David, saying, Do not come back without him, take him in his bed, so that I may put him to death.

verses.en: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.
verses.pt: Vindo, pois, os mensageiros, eis que estava a estátua na cama, e a pele de cabra à sua cabeceira.
verses.en_web: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
verses.en_bbe: And when the men came in, there was the image in the bed, with the cushion of goat's hair at its head

verses.en: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
verses.pt: Então perguntou Saul a Mical: Por que assim me enganaste, e deixaste o meu inimigo ir e escapar? Respondeu Mical a Saul: Porque ele me disse: Deixa-me ir! Por que hei de matar-te?
verses.en_web: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me thus, and let my enemy go, so that he is escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said to Michal, why have you been false to me, letting my hater go and get safely away? And in answer Michal said to Saul, He said to me, Let me go, or I will put you to death.

verses.en: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
verses.pt: Assim Davi fugiu e escapou; e indo ter com Samuel, em Ramá, contou-lhe tudo quanto Saul lhe fizera; foram, pois, ele e Samuel, e ficaram em Naiote.
verses.en_web: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.
verses.en_bbe: So David went in flight and got away and came to Ramah, to Samuel, and gave him an account of all Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and were living in Naioth.

verses.en: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.pt: E foi dito a Saul: Eis que Davi está em Naiote, em Ramá.
verses.en_web: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”
verses.en_bbe: And word was given to Saul that David was at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
verses.pt: Então enviou Saul mensageiros para prenderem a Davi; quando eles viram a congregação de profetas profetizando, e Samuel a presidi-los, o Espírito de Deus veio sobre os mensageiros de Saul, e também eles profetizaram.
verses.en_web: Saul sent messengers to seize David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul sent men to take David; and when they saw the band of prophets at work, with Samuel in his place at their head, the spirit of God came on Saul's men, and they became like prophets.

verses.en: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.
verses.pt: Avisado disso, Saul enviou outros mensageiros, e também estes profetizaram. Ainda terceira vez enviou Saul mensageiros, os quais também profetizaram.
verses.en_web: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul, having news of this, sent other men, who in the same way became like prophets. And a third time Saul sent men, and they like the others became like prophets.

verses.en: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
verses.pt: Então foi ele mesmo a Rama e, chegando ao poço grande que estava em Sécu, perguntou: Onde estão Samuel e Davi? Responderam-lhe: Eis que estão em Naiote, em Ramá.
verses.en_web: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he himself went to Ramah, and came to the great water-spring in Secu; and questioning the people he said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, They are at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.en: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.pt: Foi, pois, para Naiote, em Ramá; e o Espírito de Deus veio também sobre ele, e ele ia caminhando e profetizando, até chegar a Naiote, em Ramá.
verses.en_web: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
verses.en_bbe: And he went on from there to Naioth in Ramah: and the spirit of God came on him, and he went on, acting like a prophet, till he came to Naioth in Ramah.

verses.en: And he stript off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.pt: E despindo as suas vestes, ele também profetizou diante de Samuel; e esteve nu por terra todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite. Pelo que se diz: Está também Saul entre os profetas?
verses.en_web: He also stripped off his clothes, and he also prophesied before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.en_bbe: And he took off his clothing, acting like a prophet before Samuel, and falling down he was stretched out, without his clothing, all that day and all that night. This is the reason for the saying, Is even Saul among the prophets?
